productSpec.title: Interactive High-Roller Plinko Multiplier
productSpec.problem_statement: Physics-based Plinko peg drop with Provably Fair HMAC-SHA256 calculations and luxury coin sound effects.

user_experience.primary_flow: User triggers action from UI -> System responds with tactile feedback and state updates.
user_experience.visual_theme: Dark luxury glassmorphism (#07090e base, #ffd700 gold, #53fc18 neon green)

acceptance_criteria: Zero UI layout thrashing or horizontal overflow across 1440px, 768px, and 390px viewports.
100% compliant with Kick gambling guidelines (+18 disclaimer, zero spectator money custody).
OBS Browser Source CPU consumption remains <= 5%.

techSpec.title: Interactive High-Roller Plinko Multiplier — Architecture & Technical Spec
techSpec.architecture_tier: Web Platform + Cloudflare Durable Objects / D1
security_invariants: Spectator input rendered strictly via textContent or escaped template literals.
Zero eval() or new Function() calls.
All remote network calls protected by AbortSignal.timeout(2500-3500ms).
